prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Character reference image only: preserve exactly this character's hand-drawn dark fantasy insect design, colors, costume and weapons. Create ONE production animation sheet for ONLY this character. Draw exactly FOUR columns by EIGHT rows: 32 separate full-body sprites. The output must be tall portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, 4-column/8-row atlas. Transparent background, actual alpha. No text, no grid, no backgrounds. Each cell has its own fully isolated sprite with large blank gutters; keep the complete character including all limbs/weapons within 75% cell width and 80% cell height, never touching neighboring sprites. Right-facing side view, consistent character scale, stable feet/hover baseline in all cells. Every row must contain exactly FOUR poses. Row 1: four idle breaths. Row 2: first four walk/flight poses contact down passing up. Row 3: next four walk/flight poses with opposite limbs/wings/contact down passing up. Row 4: four progressive attack anticipation/windup poses. Row 5: four progressive strike/release/follow-through attack poses. Row 6: four recovery poses returning to rest. Row 7: four hurt/recoil poses. Row 8: four progressive death collapse poses, each fits in its own cell even when lying flat. Real joint/body/weapon/wing articulation; no duplicated stamps or translations. Preserve original detailed painted ink 2D style, no pixel art, no3D. Character:  CRITICAL: each sprite is SMALL within its cell: total character width INCLUDING weapon maximum 50% of cell width. Large empty gutters keep swords and dead bodies separated. a low broad crab shaped armored pilgrim with two heavy stone wheel shells and rust red hanging banners
